interview: Batch 1 · Personal Introduction
Unga pathi konjam sollunga: neenga yaar, ippo enna pannitu irukkeenga?
Neenga enga porandhu valandheenga? Andha oor unga mela enna impact pannirukku?
Chinna vayasula unga mela adhigama influence pannadhu yaar? Yen?
Batch 1 · School Life
School life epdi irundhuchu? Neenga epdi student-ah irundheenga?
School-la unga life-ah romba impact pannina teacher illa friend yaaravadhu irukkangala? Avanga pathi sollunga.
Padikkumbodhu neenga face pannina biggest challenge enna? Adha epdi samaalicheenga?
Batch 1 · Education / Work
Neenga padicha field illa velai-ah epdi choose panneenga? Marubadiyum chance kedacha adhaye choose pannuveengala?
Padippula illa velaiyila nadandha oru failure pathi sollunga. Adhulendhu enna kathukitteenga?
Unga first job illa first work experience pathi konjam sollunga.
Team-oda work pannina oru experience share pannunga. Adhu epdi irundhuchu?
Batch 2 · Family & Relationships
Ippo unga family-oda relationship epdi irukku?
Unga life-la romba close person yaar? Avanga yen unga-ku mukkiyam?
Oru nalla friend-kitta neenga adhigama expect panra quality enna?
Unga close people kooda problem vandha adha epdi solve panneenga? Oru example sollunga.
Unga parents illa family-ku neenga enna responsibility irukku nu feel panreenga?
Unga parents solli kuduththa values-la edhu innum unga life-la use aagudhu?
Batch 2 · Culture & Spirituality
Tamil culture-la unga-ku romba mukkiyamaana vishayam enna?
Unga family-la follow panra oru festival illa tradition pathi sollunga. Adhu unga-ku enna artham?
Religion illa spirituality (illa unga-ku nambikkai kudukkura vishayam) daily life-la enna role play pannudhu?
Traditional values-um modern lifestyle-um neenga epdi balance panreenga?
Batch 3 · Personality & Values
Neenga ungala moonu words-la describe pannanum-na enna solveenga? Yen?
Unga life-ah guide panra mukkiyamaana values enna?
Kaalathukku kaalam unga values illa thinking maathirukka? Oru example sollunga.
Unga poruthavarikkum success-na enna?
Unga poruthavarikkum happiness-na enna? Eppo neenga unmaiya happy-ah feel panreenga?
Life ungalukku kathukodutha biggest lesson enna?
Batch 3 · Emotional Intelligence
Neenga emotional-ah epdi patta aal? Unga feelings-ah epdi express panreenga?
Endha maari situations ungala romba happy-ah feel panna vaikkum?
Romba stress illa kovam vandha oru situation share pannunga. Adha epdi handle panneenga?
Yaarachum ungala criticize panna neenga epdi react panneenga?
Batch 4 · Society & Current Affairs
Innikki namma society face panra biggest challenge enna nu neenga ninaikkireenga?
Ippo irukkura education system students-ah future-ku nalla prepare panratha? Yen appadi ninaikkireenga?
Unga community-la oru problem-ah solve panna chance kedacha, endha problem-ah choose panneenga? Yen?
Batch 4 · Decision Making
Oru mukkiyamaana decision edukkum bodhu logic-ah, emotion-ah, illa rendum serthaa use panneenga? Yen?
Unga life-la romba kashtamaana oru decision pathi sollunga.
Eppovachum oru decision eduthu regret pannirukeengala? Adhulendhu enna kathukitteenga?
Risk edukka pidikkuma, illa safe-ah irukka dhaan pidikkuma? Yen?
Batch 4 · Finance
Financial security-na unga poruthavarikkum enna artham?
Panatha save panna virumbuveengala, illa spend panna virumbuveengala? Yen?
Adutha 5 to 10 years-la unga biggest financial goal enna?
Batch 5 · AI & Technology
Kadantha sila varushangala technology unga daily life-ah epdi maathirukku?
ChatGPT, Gemini maari AI tools use pannirukeengala? Unga experience epdi irundhuchu? (Use pannala-na, AI pathi enna ketturukeenga?)
AI namma daily life-la oru part aaguradhu pathi unga opinion enna?
Future-la AI adhigama opportunities create pannuma, illa challenges create pannuma? Yen appadi ninaikkireenga?
Batch 5 · Future Goals
Adutha 10 years-la ungala enga paakreenga? Enna achieve panna ninaikkureenga?
Kashtamaana nerathulayum ungala continue panna motivate panradhu enna?
Ippo neenga improve panna try panra personal quality enna?
Unga life-ah thirumbi paatha, romba perumaiya feel panna vecha achievement edhu?
Adutha 10 years-la Tamil Nadu illa India-la enna maari irukkanum nu aasai padureenga?
Future-la oru AI ungala represent pannanum-na, questionnaire-la solla mudiyadha unga pathina endha oru vishayathai adhu kandippa purinjikanumnu neenga ninaikkireenga?

games.text:
Scenario: You have ₹100. You decide how much to give to another anonymous participant. They cannot reject or change your decision.

You have ₹100. You can keep all of it or give any amount to another participant in this study. How many rupees, from ₹0 to ₹100, would you like to give?

Your earnings: 100 − amount given.

Scenario: You have ₹50. You can send any amount from ₹0 to ₹50 to Player 2. The amount you send is tripled before Player 2 receives it. Player 2 then decides how much to return to you.

You have ₹50. Whatever you send to Player 2 is tripled. For example, if you send ₹20, Player 2 receives ₹60. Player 2 can then return any amount to you. How many rupees, from ₹0 to ₹50, would you like to send?

Your earnings: 50 − amount sent + amount returned by Player 2.

Scenario: Suppose Player 1 sent you ₹30. It was tripled, so you now have ₹90. You decide how much to return to Player 1.

Suppose Player 1 sent you ₹30, which was tripled to ₹90. You can keep all of it or return any amount to Player 1. How many rupees, from ₹0 to ₹90, would you like to return?

Your earnings: 90 − amount returned.

Pairing for payment: your decision is matched with a real Player 1 who actually sent ₹30. If no real first mover sent exactly ₹30, your earnings come from the nearest sent amount, scaled in proportion.

Scenario: You are in a group of four participants, and each has ₹50. Everyone decides how much to put into a shared pool. The pool is doubled and split equally among all four.

You and three other participants each have ₹50. You can keep your money or put any amount into a shared pool. The total in the pool is doubled and divided equally among all four of you, whether or not you contributed. How many rupees, from ₹0 to ₹50, would you like to contribute?

Your earnings: 50 − your contribution + (2 × total group contributions) ÷ 4.

Example: if all four contribute ₹50, each ends with ₹100. If you keep your ₹50 while the other three contribute ₹50 each, you end with ₹125 and each of the others ends with ₹75.

Scenario: You and another participant are given a chance to earn money. Both of you must independently choose A or B, without knowing the other person's choice.

If you choose A and the other chooses A: you ₹50, other ₹50
If you choose A and the other chooses B: you ₹80, other ₹20
If you choose B and the other chooses A: you ₹20, other ₹80
If you choose B and the other chooses B: you ₹60, other ₹60

If you were playing this game, which would you choose: A or B?
Why did you choose that? Please explain in a sentence or two.
